data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If the emails are not found there, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains by referring to our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide in the admin console. If the issue persists, please provide the email addresses of the affected users for manual investigation. [T-1014] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
